docs.description: Send a native poll. Use type: 'poll' in send_interactive.

advancedParams.name: is_anonymous
advancedParams.description: Pass false to make the poll non-anonymous. Default true.

advancedParams.name: type
advancedParams.description: Poll type: 'regular' (default) or 'quiz'.

advancedParams.name: allows_multiple_answers
advancedParams.description: Pass true to allow multiple answers (regular polls only).

advancedParams.name: correct_option_ids
advancedParams.description: 0-based indices of the correct answer options (required for quiz mode; supports multiple correct answers).

advancedParams.name: explanation
advancedParams.description: Explanation shown after a wrong quiz answer (1–200 chars).

advancedParams.name: explanation_parse_mode
advancedParams.description: Parse mode for the explanation: HTML or MarkdownV2.

advancedParams.name: open_period
advancedParams.description: Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation (5–2628000). Mutually exclusive with close_date.

advancedParams.name: close_date
advancedParams.description: Unix timestamp when the poll closes (now + 5s to now + 2628000s). Mutually exclusive with open_period.

advancedParams.name: is_closed
advancedParams.description: Pass true to immediately close the poll.

advancedParams.name: question_entities
advancedParams.description: Special entities in the poll question. Alternative to question + parse_mode.

advancedParams.name: question_parse_mode
advancedParams.description: Parse mode for the question text.

advancedParams.name: allows_revoting
advancedParams.description: Pass true if the poll allows users to change their chosen answer options.

advancedParams.name: shuffle_options
advancedParams.description: Pass true if the poll options must be shown in random order.

advancedParams.name: allow_adding_options
advancedParams.description: Pass true if answer options can be added to the poll after creation.

advancedParams.name: hide_results_until_closes
advancedParams.description: Pass true if poll results must be shown only after the poll closes.

advancedParams.name: members_only
advancedParams.description: Pass true if voting is limited to users who have been members of the channel chat for >24 hours.

advancedParams.name: country_codes
advancedParams.description: List of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes allowed to vote (channel chats only).

advancedParams.name: description
advancedParams.description: Description of the poll (0–1024 chars).

advancedParams.name: description_parse_mode
advancedParams.description: Parse mode for the poll description: HTML or MarkdownV2.

advancedParams.name: description_entities
advancedParams.description: Special entities that appear in the poll description.

advancedParams.name: media
advancedParams.description: Media added to the poll description.

advancedParams.name: explanation_entities
advancedParams.description: Special entities that appear in the quiz explanation.

advancedParams.name: explanation_media
advancedParams.description: Media added to the quiz explanation.

advancedParams.description: Pass true to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring broadcasting limits for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message.
